description: This file defines the OpenmrsClassLoader class, a custom class loader used in the OpenMRS project. It manages class loading from different module class loaders and handles resource expansion, caching, garbage collection, and cleanup related to OpenMRS modules.

classes.name: OpenmrsClassLoader
classes.description: A custom URLClassLoader that manages class loading from OpenMRS module class loaders, handles resource expansion, caching, garbage collection, and cleanup for dynamic module management.

methods.name: loadClass
methods.description: Overrides default class loading to load classes from module class loaders first, then parent class loader, with caching.

methods.name: findResource
methods.description: Finds resources within module class loaders, expands jar URLs if needed.

methods.name: findResources
methods.description: Finds multiple resources across all module class loaders and parent, returns aggregated URLs.

methods.name: getResourceAsStream
methods.description: Retrieves resource input stream from module class loaders first, then parent.

methods.name: getResources
methods.description: Returns enumeration of all resources matching a name from module class loaders or parent.

methods.name: destroyInstance
methods.description: Dismantles the singleton class loader instance, stopping threads and clearing references to facilitate garbage collection.

methods.name: setThreadsToNewClassLoader
methods.description: Reassigns threads to the new class loader after reload or disposal.

methods.name: getLibCacheFolder
methods.description: Returns or creates the folder used for caching expanded jar libraries.

methods.name: expandURL
methods.description: Expands jar URLs into temporary cache folder for class/resource access.

methods.name: saveState
methods.description: Saves the current scheduler state in a memento for restoration after reload.

methods.name: restoreState
methods.description: Restores SchedulerService state from saved memento.

methods.name: flushInstance
methods.description: Reinitializes scheduler tasks after class loader reload.
